## java.nio.file

`Path` and `Files` are the modern API. Read a whole file with `Files.readString`, stream lines with `Files.lines` (close the stream!), write with `Files.writeString`.

## Buffering

For large data use buffered readers/writers or channels. Always use try-with-resources.

## Encoding

Specify `StandardCharsets.UTF_8` explicitly — don't rely on the platform default.
